theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A clean, modern light theme is explicitly requested. Archetype 4 ensures data density, high-contrast readability for live score numbers, and functional clarity while allowing bold team colors to act as functional accents rather than mere decoration.

typography.rules: Strict adherence to the Anti-Default rule. Inter is banned for headings.

headings.usage: Used for massive live scores, match titles, and section headers. Gives a dynamic, sporty, and technical feel.

body.usage: Used for commentary, player stats, and general UI text. Provides excellent legibility at small sizes in dense scorecards.

mono.usage: Used for strike rates, economy rates, and specific data points where tabular lining is crucial.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: High density for scorecards, generous breathing room between distinct modules (matches).

containers.border_radius: rounded-lg (Max 8px for a sharp, sporty, technical look)
containers.max_width: max-w-md mx-auto w-full (for mobile-app web feel)

navigation.bottom_tabs: Fixed to bottom, `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80` with a 1px `border-t border-black/5`. Unselected icons in neutral grey, selected icons in dark charcoal with a tiny indicator dot.

match_cards.style: Flat card, `border border-black/5`, no shadow. Subtle shadow on interaction. Team colors represented via thin accent borders or colored typography.
match_cards.live_badge: Pulsing red dot with 'LIVE' in JetBrains Mono.

live_match_intelligence.wagon_wheel: Custom SVG or layered div structure showing a cricket field from top-down with radiating lines for runs.
live_match_intelligence.manhattan_chart: Use Recharts for a tight, dense bar chart showing runs per over.
live_match_intelligence.win_o_meter: Horizontal progress bar (`h-2 rounded-full`) split into two team colors. No gradients, solid colors.

ball_by_ball_commentary.layout: Vertical timeline. The current over is highlighted with a soft grey background.
ball_by_ball_commentary.ball_circle: Small circle (`w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold`) colored by outcome: Red for W, Green for 6, Blue for 4.

buttons_and_inputs.primary: Solid dark charcoal (`bg-[#111418] text-white`) with strict 8px radius.
buttons_and_inputs.secondary: Ghost or subtle outline (`bg-white border border-black/10 text-[#111418]`).

motion_and_interaction.live_updates: Data changes (runs, wickets) must flash briefly with a yellow/green background tint (`bg-yellow-100` fading to transparent over 1s) to draw attention.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Slide-in from right for deep links (match details), fade-in for tab switches.
motion_and_interaction.buttons: Scale down slightly (`active:scale-95`) for tactile mobile feedback.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width of 2 for a crisp, legible appearance at small sizes.

onboarding_hero.description: Dynamic cricket match scene with batsman, wicketkeeper, and fielder in action. Perfect for the app's welcome or auth screen.

team_placeholder_or_fan_community.description: Exciting cricket match with crowds wearing yellow jerseys under clear blue sky. Use for Community / Chat / Fan sections.

default_match_background.description: Captivating night cricket match with a large crowd at a stadium. Use as an optional header background for high-profile matches with a heavy `bg-white/90` overlay.

stats_or_pitch_graphic.description: Close-up of a cricket ball on a grassy pitch. Good for generic 'News' or 'Articles' thumbnail.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a mobile web app using React Web with an Expo/Mobile feel. The main wrapper should constrain the width (e.g., `max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-gray-50`) to simulate a phone layout on desktop.
Do NOT use transparent navigation headers without a solid or frosted blur background to ensure text remains readable.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts like the 'Wagon Wheel' or 'Win-o-meter' if Recharts feels too bulky. For dense data tables (Scorecards), strip out default padding to maximize space.
Team colors should be implemented dynamically via inline styles for backgrounds/borders of specific accent elements, falling back to a CSS variable.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="match-card-csk-mi"`, `data-testid="nav-home"`).
Do not use generic 'Inter' font. Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body. Install these via Google Fonts in the main HTML/CSS.
Live score numbers must be massive and unmistakable. Avoid excessive use of cards; flat surfaces with 1px borders are preferred over heavy drop shadows.
